note: Assesses open availability of land data in Sudan; states no register, its digital status, coverage or online service.
Document is about the commercial registry only.

facts.fact: Ayin Network quotes an Omdurman land-registration employee saying an electronic database of land records with backup copies is used to check ownership, matched against surviving paper records.
Almndra News reports that the Sudan Registrar General of Lands ordered land registry offices to check that the paper record matches the current electronic record before issuing search certificates.
